svg.title: Nutritional support: if the gut works, feed into it, by nasal tube for under 3 weeks or by gastrostomy or jejunostomy beyond 6 weeks, with a formula matched to the gut; if it does not, parenteral nutrition, peripheral (mostly fat) or central (mostly glucose), started only after 7 days without food (5 if malnourished); watch any route for refeeding syndrome
